facts.fact: Decree-law no. 2023-17 of 11 March 2023 on cybersecurity, published in JORT no. 26, sets audit, labelling, classification, incident-response and critical-infrastructure duties for public and private bodies with fines of 50,000 to 100,000 dinars; its Article 30 brings it into force six months after publication, and the database record gives its status as in force.
